description: terrains/alpine.lua at 8 m, the plain under 2 m left out as in the references. The checks are artefact guards: an eroded massif drains (few closed depressions), has no spikes two samples wide (slope p99.9) and no structure aligned with the grid. The targets are scale-free numbers measured on docs/references/alpine/1-4.png (spectral slope 3.92 to 3.98, hypsometric integral 0.27 to 0.31, all with --level 2); heightmap1.jpg and heightmap2.jpg are shaded relief, not heights, and are not used.
